post.description:
PLC trigger: inspect one part with the quality analyzer and record it.

An industrial cycle (simulated=false) without image is recorded as ERROR
(CAPTURE_FAILED): no synthetic image is ever used for it.

200.description: Idempotent replay: the cycle already existed

409.description: Same cycle already recorded with another image/camera/source

get.description: KPIs of a station over [from, to). Defaults: the last 8 hours. Naive times = UTC.

AIPrediction.title: AIPrediction
AIPrediction.description: Snapshot of the quality inference that produced a part verdict. Immutable.

simulated.title: Simulated
simulated.description: true = simulated PLC cycle (synthetic image if none sent)

physical_inspection.title: Physical Inspection
physical_inspection.description: Must be true to correct a HOLD or ERROR part: the part was inspected.

CorrectionIn.title: CorrectionIn
CorrectionIn.description:
Human verdict on a part, after looking at the physical part.

``expected_current_verdict`` is an optimistic lock: the correction is refused if the
part changed in the meantime (two screens, double click).

Event.title: Event
Event.description: An analysis result after the decision layer: this is what is stored and served.

FeedbackIn.title: FeedbackIn
FeedbackIn.description: Operator verdict, as sent to the API.

FrameMeta.title: FrameMeta
FrameMeta.description: Metadata of one image coming from a source.

Part.title: Part
Part.description: One physical part presented by a PLC cycle.

person_index.title: Person Index
person_index.description: Index in this frame only, not a tracking id

PersonPPE.title: PersonPPE
PersonPPE.description: One detected person. Position in the image only: NO identity, NO face data.

ProductionKPI.title: ProductionKPI
ProductionKPI.description:
Production indicators over a window. Rates are None when their denominator is 0.

Counts use the EFFECTIVE verdict; ``predicted_*`` counts keep the AI view.
HOLD and ERROR parts are never counted as OK nor as NOK.

heatmap_ref.title: Heatmap Ref
heatmap_ref.description: Optional reference (path/URL) to a heatmap. Never inline.

Thresholds.title: Thresholds
Thresholds.description: Two thresholds per use case: score < low -> conforme, score >= high -> anomalie.

UseCaseInfo.title: UseCaseInfo
UseCaseInfo.description: Description of a loaded use case, served by GET /use-cases.

review_rate.title: Review Rate
review_rate.description: Share of a_verifier among all events.
